runs.text: Which name suits the box that holds how many slices a pizza has?
A box's name is for the people who read the program. The computer accepts any name; your classmates, and you in a week, need one that says what it holds.

justification.text: It is short, but it does not say what it holds: slices, people or pizzas?
It says nothing about the problem.
It reads by itself: slices per pizza. Anyone knows what the box holds.
Every box in the party holds numbers.
